listing.summary: Adds a new faction with ships, weapons, and fighters, along with updates to the United Council faction.

Changelog

Spoiler
2026/9/29 
Additions:
Battlegroup XVI
- 3 new Ships: Takao-class heavy cruiser, Invictus (XVI), Helena-class light cruiser
- 1 new fighter wing: Firemoth(automated)
- 2 new weapons
- new System: Fortress barrier
United Council
- 3 new Weapons
- 2 new Ships Klyatva-class battleship, Chang Kong-class Carrier
Changes:
- reduced synergy mounts on the Onslaught type II
- replaced the unifinshed Raikou-class cruiser with the Helena-class cruiser
- reduces max ammo on the Kiri-type canister rack (15 -> 5)
- improved the visual effects of the Heavy Varja cannon, warp cannon and Heavy Pulsar Cannon

Fixes:
- fixed a bug where the game will crash if Bionic Alteration is enabled
2026/7/30 
Additions:
- 4 Weapons for the United Council
- 2 United Council fighters wings
- 2 [REDACTED] large mount energy weapons
- 2 [REDACTED] ships
Changes:
- custom stars no longer spawn for procedurally generated systems

2026/7/16 hotfix
- fixed a variant file with incorrect ship ID and errors in default_ship_roles.json causing the game to crash and added sprites for the torpedoes launchers

Credits

Spoiler
Portraits: taken from the no longer available game Echoes of Pandora
